attachments.insertion_landmark: hyoid body and a median fibrous raphe with the contralateral muscle

actions: elevates the floor of the mouth and hyoid (e.g. during the first stage of swallowing)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Paired sheet forming the entire muscular floor of the mouth, meeting its contralateral partner at the median raphe.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

trigger_points.location_description: Muscle belly under the mandible (submental region).
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: Tongue (pain felt 'in the tongue'), lower teeth, and throat.
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons Trigger Point Manual -- as cited in this atlas's uploaded head and neck muscle reference document (Simons DG, Travell JG, Simons LS, Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual, Vol 1, 2nd ed., Williams & Wilkins, 1999)
